one_line_thesis: Gladstone Land is an externally managed farmland REIT (~99k acres across 14 states plus California water assets) — land-sleeve triple-net lease income with periodic farm sales; NAV vs monthly dividend yield pending deep dive.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Gladstone Land is a diversified U.S. farmland landlord: triple-net leases on row and permanent crops, California water rights, and an active sell-and-reinvest rotation program. FY2025 AFFO of $0.393 per share covered only ~70% of the $0.56 annual dividend; Q1 2026 coverage fell to ~54% as fixed base rent declined after dispositions while participation rent remained lumpy. Leverage is manageable (~$486 million total indebtedness, mostly fixed-rate) but Q1 ATM issuance added 3.7 million shares. At ~$9.23, our base case annual return is 2.2% per year on normalized owner cash of $0.38 per share...

method_fit.rule: Use one primary method and no more than two corroborating methods; irrelevant methods and personas remain silent.
